description: Deterministic parsing library for Dungeons & Dragons 5e imports.

approaches.userExplanation: D&D 5e uses 6 base attributes, which we map to the 5 Multiverse Approaches. STR becomes Force, DEX becomes Precision, CON becomes Fortitude, CHA becomes Presence, and the higher of INT or WIS becomes Insight. The character is then assigned a Base 12 array of [3, 3, 2, 2, 2]. We assign a '3' to your class's Primary Abilities. The remaining '3' (if your class only has one Primary Ability) is given to your highest remaining translated raw score (including modifiers). If there is a tie for the remaining top stats, the engine will leave the core point unassigned so you can resolve the tie manually.

powerScale.userExplanation: In the Multiverse, Power Scale represents your tier of play and determines your base inventory slots. Level 1-4 is Power Scale 1 (7 Slots). Level 5-10 is Power Scale 2 (9 Slots). Level 11-16 is Power Scale 3 (11 Slots). Level 17-20 is Power Scale 4 (13 Slots). You also import with Translation EXP based on your level, allowing you to buy tags.

slotTaxes.userExplanation: Major items tax your inventory slots. Weapons, Armor, and Wondrous Items usually cost 1 slot. Mundane items and class features do not cost slots.

pathTagDefinitions.userExplanation: Path Tags are extracted strictly based on an exact property Manifest. No guessing.
